The words “of circuit-I shall be borne by the Meja Urja Nigam Private Ltd. till commissioning of Meja generating station” in the last sentence of para 13 of the order shall be read as “ .of the said line from its COD till the date of start of LTA of Meja Generating Station shall be borne by MUNPL.” b. The 11 th line of para 27, starting with the words “Therefore” to the end of para 27 of the order shall be read as under:- - “ Therefore, the time taken from 5.5.2016 to date of COD of Asset-1(a) and Asset-1(b) is attributable to Meja Urja Nigam Private Limited and hence the IDC and IEDC for this period shall be borne by MUNPL. The IDC and IEDC for the period 5.4.2016 to 4.5.2016 shall be capitalized.” - c. The second and third sentences of para 59 of the order shall be read as under:- - “ The transmission charges of the instant transmission line from the date of COD of the transmission line till date of start of LTA of Meja Generating Station shall be borne by MUNPL as directed in para 27 and thereafter the transmission charges shall be shared as per Regulation 43 of the 2014 Tariff Regulations.” Corrigendum to order dated 5.10.2017 in Petition No. 203/TT/2016 Page **4** of **5** 2. All other terms of the order dated 5.10.2017 remains unchanged. sd/sd/sd/- **(Dr. M.K. Iyer) (A.S. Bakshi) (A.K.
